model_hubs.model_name_zh: Bajaj Boxer CT100 / Boxer BM100 商用两轮平台
model_hubs.engine_code: CT100 / BM100 OHC (DU10 / DD10 / PF Ref.)
model_hubs.summary_en: Built to Indian OEM 4-stroke air-cooled SOHC architecture (99.27 cc classic spec: 6.03 kW / 8.2 PS @ 7,500 rpm, 8.05 N·m @ 4,500 rpm, 9.5:1 compression, 4-speed constant mesh, 1.0 L oil capacity, 428-14T sprocket). Available both as complete replacement engines and as core overhaul castings/kits, consolidated in mixed containers with Chinese CG/CB engines. Built to OEM-equivalent displacement, bore × stroke, and mounting dimensions.
model_hubs.summary_zh: 严格对标印度原厂四冲程风冷顶置凸轮轴（OHC）平台规格（经典 99.27 cc 版：53.0×45.0 mm，6.03 kW / 8.2 PS @ 7,500 rpm，8.05 N·m @ 4,500 rpm，压缩比 9.5:1，国际 4 挡常啮合，脚启动，机油容量 1.0 L，428-14T 输出链轮；另可按单确认 102 cc 长行程 47.0×58.8 mm 版）。支持整机总成及重点核心件出口，并可与中国 CG/CB 整机同柜混装发运。 按原厂同等排量、缸径×行程及车架安装尺寸制造。

model_hubs.model_name_zh: Bajaj Boxer BM150 商用两轮主力（非洲 Boda-Boda / 拉美）
model_hubs.summary_en: Flagship commercial utility platform across Nigeria, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, and Latin America: 144.8 cc single-cylinder air-cooled SOHC 2-valve engine (56.0 × 58.8 mm, 9.5:1 compression), 4-speed / 5-speed international mesh transmission, kick & electric start, single or DTS-i twin-spark variants. Available as complete replacement engines and high-turnover castings/kits for mixed container loading. Built to OEM-equivalent displacement, bore × stroke, and mounting dimensions.
